rationale: Compresses the early bootstrap to a single Carrot cycle liquidated on Day 3 morning to immediately transition 100% of plots into hyper-fertilized Strawberries, capturing 7-8 lifetime recurring flushes per plot while freezing land expansion strictly at 22-24 contiguous plots by Day 13 with 10-11 hands. Raises the uncontracted surplus liquidation trigger to 14 items (or shed_used >= 36) after Day 3 to protect inventory buffers for 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop arbitrage, abolishing 75% backpack gating and pre-harvest well detours in micro-dispatch. Enforces a hard Day 22 seed procurement freeze to ban low-margin endgame Carrot backfills, dedicating all late labor to Strawberry flushes and progressive terminal liquidation across steps 706-718.
